name: Newsreel Theater
description: The news as moviegoers saw it from the 1930s to the 60s: Universal Newsreel stories and complete reels, Pathé News digests, Fox Movietone, News of the Day, wartime United Newsreels and Castle Films' News Parade of the Year, from the Hindenburg and Pearl Harbor to Sputnik, the Berlin Wall and the Cuban Missile Crisis. Every Sunday at 8:00 pm, a full hour of The March of Time.
curated: 2026-10-15: about 70 hours of 1929-1967 American newsreels (Universal's own archive and complete Universal Newsreel releases from the National Archives, Pathé, Movietone, News of the Day, United News and Castle News Parade) plus a March of Time slot; Axis and Soviet newsreels, raw outtakes and stock-footage excerpts, silent home-movie prints, a theatre trailer, duplicate uploads and modern YouTube re-uploads excluded.
